title: Type line
description: The type-line characteristic of one face, decomposed into supertypes, card types, and subtypes (CR 205). The separator is derived from which parts are present, so it is not stored. Referenced from card/component/face.schema.json.

supertypes.description: IDs of the face's supertypes. Left out when there are none.

card_types.description: IDs of the face's card types. A face can have more than one card type (CR 205.2b).

subtypes.description: IDs of the face's subtypes. Each subtype's component record lists the card types it can accompany. Left out when there are none.

word_id.description: The id of a value in a list under data/oracle/card/component/, whose word a language shows.
